content.short: Filipinos use Coins.ph to trade crypto in pesos, pay bills and send money, under a licence from the Philippine central bank.
content.description: Coins.ph ranks among the most-used crypto apps in the Philippines, and the country's central bank, the BSP, licenses it. Users buy and sell crypto in pesos, send money to family, pay bills, top up mobile credit and scan QR Ph codes at hundreds of thousands of stores. Pesos can be cashed in through local banks and outlets, which makes it a practical everyday wallet as well as an exchange. No virtual currency exchange in the country was licensed by the central bank before it, users can settle more than a hundred kinds of bills, and its Bitcoin Builder Program rewards people in BTC.
